description: This PHP script provides sample client implementations for TestLink's XML-RPC API, including functions to retrieve test cases, create test projects, and fetch test suites associated with test plans. It appears to be a test or demonstration script rather than core application logic.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A class used to make XML-RPC requests to the server.

methods.name: tl.getTestCasesForTestPlan
methods.description: Retrieves test cases linked to a specific test plan.

methods.name: tl.createTestProject
methods.description: Creates a new test project in TestLink.

methods.name: tl.getTestSuitesForTestPlan
methods.description: Fetches test suites associated with a specified test plan.
